observations.body: Jesus comes to John for baptism. The heavens open, the Spirit descends like a dove, and a heavenly voice names Jesus as the beloved Son.

payload.posture: Read Matthew 3:13–17 as one movement in the temptation of Jesus, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus comes to John for baptism. The heavens open, the Spirit descends like a dove, and a heavenly voice names Jesus as the beloved Son. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the temptation of Jesus.
payload.title: The Spirit descends and the voice names the beloved Son
